offering_description.value: Palomar underwrites specialty insurance for homeowners, businesses and agricultural producers, with earthquake coverage as a core line. It also offers fronting services to insurance program operators and distributes coverage through agents, brokers and program partners.

primary_products.value: Residential and commercial earthquake insurance; specialty casualty insurance; crop insurance; inland marine and other specialty property insurance; surety bonds

customer_segment.value: B2B: Commercial property owners, businesses, agricultural producers, contractors and insurance program operators; B2C: Homeowners buying earthquake coverage

end_markets.value: Residential property; commercial real estate; agriculture; construction; specialty insurance programs

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Premiums for specialty insurance policies and surety bonds; service fees: Fees from program operators for issuing policies under Palomar’s insurance licenses

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Underwrites risks submitted by brokers and program partners and issues coverage to households and businesses

geography_served.value: US national: United States, including earthquake markets on the West Coast and in Hawaii

specialization.value: related lines: Earthquake, casualty, crop, inland marine and other property coverage, surety and insurance program fronting

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent insurance agents, retail brokers and wholesale brokers; partners / resellers: Managing general agents and other insurance program administrators

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance departments oversee carrier licensing, solvency and admitted insurance rates and policy forms.

notes: The relative size and ordering of the lines beyond earthquake coverage are uncertain.
